quest.title: Tea or Bulle Fruit?
quest.description: Go to the viewing deck in Nasha Town, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with the guests...

talks.objective: Head near the viewing deck in Nasha Town to start the tea party
Head near the viewing deck in Nasha Town to start the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Please accept my gratitude, Miss Sandrone, on behalf of Miss Mamere, for your kind invitation.

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Mmhmm, this food is delicious. Thank you, Sandrone. Your culinary skills are amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: But Prototype 4ACV07, I believe this is the first time we've met? How did you recognize me?

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Whoa, that's the first time I've heard anyone call Seymour that...

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Affirmative. Although I am familiar with your gentleness and radiance, I have never seen you in the flesh before, Miss Sandrone.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: I can recognize you because your appearance is an exact match of my master, Miss Mary-Ann Guillotin. Her image is permanently recorded in my memory unit.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Miss Mary-Ann told me about you. Since your appearance matches hers, the logical reasoning required to recognize you is quite simple, Miss Sandrone.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hah, even Alain's earliest work is so impressive. Though it appears you've had a few enhancements made... I suppose I should address you as Seymour now?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Were you confused when you saw me?

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Negative. My primary directive is to accompany and protect Miss Mary-Ann on behalf of Alain Guillotin.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: As such, my knowledge of Miss Mary-Ann is complete. And based on a logical analysis of finite-dimensional vector spaces, you and Miss Mary-Ann are totally different, Miss Sandrone.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Like the difference between the tea leaves of Chenyu Vale and the Beryl Region's Bulle Fruit.

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Is Sandrone the tea or the Bulle Fruit?

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Searching... Insufficient data. Unable to answer.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: (*sigh*... I'm glad Alain improved his language module design by the time he created me.)

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Huh!? So soon? Thank you, Miss Sandrone! I hope to see you next time!
